note: Write-intent rows before augmentation. One row per goal; cands are the write candidates with act (none/request/mention/question/report/retract), value (alert on/off, save/unsave, checklist done/undo, status planning/applied/waiting/received/abandoned, na) and target (on_screen/saved/selected/none). Sources: act_rows (author rounds 11/13/14/15 and re-reviews 8-11, acts hand-labelled per candidate on feat/act-head), train_v3 (router rows; read rows have no candidate), act_test (re-reviews 12-13: dev only), au16 (new author rows at a realistic prior: dev 80% / internal test 20% by group). Values and targets were filled by labelling patterns once and corrected by hand where listed in build_data.py; they are labels, not runtime rules. fresh2 (2026-11-27): hand-written train rows for the holdout v3 card misses (a write with a read, two writes, colloquial endings, a reason after the request, English words, the saved list as target), written without access to the evaluation sets.
